summary: Catherine broke her ankle in two places on a steep, leaf-covered descent of the Gray Copper Trail about 1.5 miles from the trailhead; her party activated a ResQLink PLB and Ouray Search and Rescue responded, coordinating an evacuation with an ambulance meeting the party at the trailhead
location: Gray Copper Trail, behind Red Mountain off U.S. 550
notes: First-hand dated survivor testimonial (five-woman party hiking in rain); PLB activation relayed via Air Force; victim surname not given
